AI Overview
Elementle
Video game
Elemental: War of Magic is a fantasy 4X turn-based strategy and role-playing game developed and published by Stardock, released for Microsoft Windows on August 24, 2010. 
Wikipedia
Overview and Setting
Genre: Turn-based 4X strategy combined with role-playing elements.
Setting: A post-apocalyptic magical world set after the destruction of the Forge of the Overlord and ancient wars with the Titans.
Premise: Players control immortal rulers known as "Sovereigns" to build cities, manage resources, research technology trees, and command tactical turn-based combat. 
Wikipedia
 +1
Gameplay Mechanics
Factions: Players choose between human (Kingdom) or Fallen (Empire) factions.
Magic and Shards: Harnessing power from mystical elemental shards scattered across the land.
Customization: Detailed character and unit editing, alongside world terraforming capabilities. 
Amazon.com
 +2
Reception and Legacy
Reception: The original 2010 launch faced severe technical instability, bugs, and interface challenges, resulting in a low aggregate review score.
Evolution: Stardock subsequently expanded and remade the concept through follow-ups like Fallen Enchantress and later unified the series vision in the modern 64-bit remaster, Elemental: Reforged.
